sources.entry: FMD Server - A server to communicate with the FMD (Find My Device) Android app, to locate and control your devices. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Docker/Go

summary.name: FMD
summary.one_liner: FMD is a decentralised, open-source system for locating and remotely controlling a lost Android device, made up of an Android app and a self-hostable web server.
use_cases: locate a lost or misplaced Android phone
remotely control a lost Android device
track an Android device from a web browser
summary.what_it_does: The FMD Android app locates and remotely controls an Android device, which is useful if the device is lost or misplaced. The FMD Server is a web server that connects to the Android app and provides a web interface for controlling the device. The project describes itself as decentralised remote device location and control. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes the server as written in Go and licensed GPL-3.0, with Docker support.
notable: Decentralised design with a self-hostable server
Web interface for controlling the Android device
caveats: Works only with the Android app; no iOS support is mentioned
Remote control features beyond locating are not detailed on the page
